title: Crispy Pork Ribs
description: A keto twist on a classic dish, these crispy pork ribs are perfect for adventurous eaters. They're a great combination of flavors and textures.
instructions: Rinse the pork ribs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the crispy seasoning blend, coconut oil, lime juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Coat the pork ribs evenly with the seasoning mixture, making sure they're fully covered.
In a separate bowl, mix together the almond flour and egg until a crumbly mixture forms.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese to the almond flour mixture and mix until well combined.
Coat the seasoned pork ribs with the almond flour mixture, pressing the mixture onto the meat to ensure it adheres.
Place the coated pork ribs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pork ribs in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until they're crispy and golden brown.
Remove the pork ribs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
